data: 29 hash-verified Phase 11B development frames, 2017-02-01 .. 2024-09-30; sealed period never read
excluded: direction prediction; any other feature; stock identity (never a feature)
finalists: pooled qualifiers are refit on all development rows and saved; nothing else is saved
holdout: sealed confirmation period untouched; evaluated at most once, only for finalists, only with owner approval
metrics: top-5% actual moves: mean predicted / mean actual
per-block and per-stock relative MSE improvement

models.baseline_ridge_vol: REFERENCE BASELINE: Ridge(alpha=1.0) on Volatility, spy_volatility_20
models.lightgbm: candidate: LGBMRegressor(n_estimators=300, learning_rate=0.03, num_leaves=7, max_depth=3, min_child_samples=200 pooled / 50 per stock, subsample=0.8, subsample_freq=1, colsample_bytree=0.8, reg_lambda=1.0, random_state=42, n_jobs=1, deterministic=True)
models.lightgbm_vol: descriptive control: the lightgbm candidate on the 2 volatility features only
models.random_forest: candidate: RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=200, max_depth=4, max_features=0.5, min_samples_leaf=200 pooled / 50 per stock, random_state=42, n_jobs=1)
models.scaled_vol: benchmark: c * Volatility, c = least squares through the origin on the training fold

preprocessing.missing_values: none expected; any non-finite value stops the run (no imputation)
preprocessing.pooled: the 6 non-volatility features are z-scored per stock with that stock's training-fold mean and std (std 0 -> 1); volatility features stay raw; no stock identity feature
preprocessing.ridge: inputs clipped to training-fold quantiles [0.01, 0.99], then StandardScaler fit on the training fold

qualification.Q1_improvement: relative MSE improvement over the reference >= 0.01 AND relative MAE improvement >= 0.0
qualification.Q2_statistics: Holm-adjusted one-sided DM p < 0.05 within the family AND raw p with lag 2L < 0.05
qualification.Q3_periods: MSE better than the reference in >= 3 of 4 equal consecutive blocks of test dates
qualification.Q4_leakage: every fold satisfies the gap check; the automated leakage tests pass
qualification.Q5_breadth: pooled only: MSE improved for >= 60% of stocks, and the improvement stays > 0 without the single best stock and without the single best fold
qualification.Q6_reproducibility: a second in-process run gives bit-identical predictions (pooled: every model; per stock: 5 hash-chosen stocks)
qualification.applies_to: each candidate x horizon (pooled: primary family; per stock: secondary family)
qualification.rule: QUALIFIED only if Q1-Q6 all pass; thresholds are fixed here and never changed after results

families.primary: pooled candidates x horizons = 6 comparisons, Holm
families.secondary: per-stock candidates x 29 stocks x horizons = 174 comparisons, Holm

statistics.test: one-sided Diebold-Mariano, H0: candidate squared error not lower than the reference's; pooled: per-date cross-sectional mean loss differential; per stock: that stock's series
statistics.variance: Newey-West, Bartlett kernel, lag L = max(h, ceil(T^(1/3))), T = number of test dates; 2L sensitivity

target.definition: |future_excess_return_h|, future_excess_return_h from excess_return_v1 (training.excess_targets.build_excess_targets); last h rows unlabelled

validation.gap: h: a training row i satisfies i + h < first test row (its label is complete before prediction)
validation.last_fold: a final fold shorter than 21 sessions is merged into the previous fold
validation.type: expanding-window walk-forward over the common session index, identical folds for all models
